scripts.dev: vite build --config vite.player.config.ts --logLevel warn && node scripts/build-native-player.mjs && vite --host
scripts.dev:rust: CATALYST_ENGINE=rust vite build --config vite.player.config.ts --logLevel warn && node scripts/build-native-player.mjs && CATALYST_ENGINE=rust vite --host
scripts.build: tsc && vite build --config vite.player.config.ts && node scripts/build-native-player.mjs && vite build
scripts.build:rust: tsc -p tsconfig.rust.json && CATALYST_ENGINE=rust vite build --config vite.player.config.ts && node scripts/build-native-player.mjs && CATALYST_ENGINE=rust vite build
